import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import linprog

J1=(a-2)**2/2+c*a*b;J2=(b-2)**2/2+c*a*b
br=sp.solve(sp.diff(J1,a),a)[0]

notebooks.title: 分别求均衡与共同目标
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import linprog

cells.code:
a,b,c=sp.symbols('a b c',real=True)
J1=(a-2)**2/2+c*a*b;J2=(b-2)**2/2+c*a*b;S=J1+J2
NE=sp.solve([sp.diff(J1,a),sp.diff(J2,b)],[a,b]);central=sp.solve([sp.diff(S,a),sp.diff(S,b)],[a,b])
print('NE/共同目标/Hessian:',NE,central,sp.hessian(S,(a,b)))
for v in [0,sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(9,20)]:
    n={k:x.subs(c,v) for k,x in NE.items()};z={k:x.subs(c,v) for k,x in central.items()}
    sn=sp.simplify(S.subs(n).subs(c,v));sz=sp.simplify(S.subs(z).subs(c,v))
    print('c/NE/共同目标/两总分/差:',v,n,z,sn,sz,sp.simplify(sn-sz))
    print('该c下响应端点/总分Hessian谱/NE单方改善:',[2-4*v,2],sp.hessian(S,(a,b)).subs(c,v).eigenvals(),sp.simplify(J1.subs(n).subs(c,v)-J1.subs({a:2-v*n[b],b:n[b]}).subs(c,v)))
print('默认NE各代价:',J1.subs({a:sp.Rational(8,5),b:sp.Rational(8,5),c:sp.Rational(1,4)}))
u=sp.Rational(4,3);reply=2-sp.Rational(1,4)*u
print('共同目标各代价/甲响应/甲改善:',sp.simplify(J1.subs({a:u,b:u,c:sp.Rational(1,4)})),reply,sp.simplify(J1.subs({a:u,b:u,c:sp.Rational(1,4)})-J1.subs({a:reply,b:u,c:sp.Rational(1,4)})))

notebooks.title: 匹配硬币的期望与LP
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import linprog

cells.code:
p,q=sp.symbols('p q',real=True);M=np.array([[1.,-1.],[-1.,1.]])
expr=sp.expand((sp.Matrix([[p,1-p]])*sp.Matrix(M.astype(int))*sp.Matrix([q,1-q]))[0])
print('独立期望:',sp.factor(expr),'均衡期望:',expr.subs({p:sp.Rational(1,2),q:sp.Rational(1,2)}))
print('纯最大最小/最小最大:',M.min(axis=1).max(),M.max(axis=0).min())
pure=[(i,j) for i in range(2) for j in range(2) if M[i,j]==M[:,j].max() and M[i,j]==M[i,:].min()]
print('匹配硬币纯NE:',pure)
row=linprog([0,0,-1],A_ub=np.column_stack((-M.T,np.ones(2))),b_ub=np.zeros(2),A_eq=[[1,1,0]],b_eq=[1],bounds=[(0,None),(0,None),(None,None)],method='highs')
col=linprog([0,0,1],A_ub=np.column_stack((M,-np.ones(2))),b_ub=np.zeros(2),A_eq=[[1,1,0]],b_eq=[1],bounds=[(0,None),(0,None),(None,None)],method='highs')
assert row.success and col.success
print('甲分布/保证值，乙分布/上界:',row.x,col.x)
print('p=.8的最坏收益:',min(expr.subs({p:sp.Rational(4,5),q:v}) for v in [0,1]))
print('同面公共硬币相关收益:',sp.Rational(1,2)*1+sp.Rational(1,2)*1)

notebooks.title: 势函数与非唯一均衡
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import linprog

cells.code:
a,b,c,v=sp.symbols('a b c v',real=True)
J1=(a-2)**2/2+c*a*b;J2=(b-2)**2/2+c*a*b
Phi=(a-2)**2/2+(b-2)**2/2+c*a*b
print('两位玩家单方变化差:',sp.simplify(Phi.subs(a,v)-Phi-(J1.subs(a,v)-J1)),sp.simplify(Phi.subs(b,v)-Phi-(J2.subs(b,v)-J2)))
print('势Hessian/默认谱:',sp.hessian(Phi,(a,b)),sp.hessian(Phi,(a,b)).subs(c,sp.Rational(1,4)).eigenvals())
print('默认NE势/总分:',Phi.subs({a:sp.Rational(8,5),b:sp.Rational(8,5),c:sp.Rational(1,4)}),(J1+J2).subs({a:sp.Rational(8,5),b:sp.Rational(8,5),c:sp.Rational(1,4)}))
Q=(a-b)**2
print('非唯一例各自二阶导/响应:',sp.diff(Q,a,2),sp.diff(Q,b,2),sp.solve(sp.diff(Q,a),a),sp.solve(sp.diff(Q,b),b))
print('对角线上代价:',sp.simplify(Q.subs(a,b)))

notebooks.title: 同步响应、循环与承诺
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import linprog

cells.code:
c=sp.Rational(1,4);x=sp.Matrix([0,4]);seq=[x]
for k in range(12):x=sp.Matrix([2-c*x[1],2-c*x[0]]);seq.append(x)
print('同步响应0/1/2/12轮:',[(k,seq[k],np.array(seq[k],dtype=float).reshape(-1)) for k in [0,1,2,12]])
print('第12轮精确误差:',seq[12]-sp.ones(2,1)*sp.Rational(8,5))
state=[0,0];cycle=[state.copy()]
for who in [1,0,1,0]:
    state[who]=(1-state[0]) if who==1 else state[1];cycle.append(state.copy())
print('匹配硬币乙甲乙甲，0正1反:',cycle)
a=sp.symbols('a',real=True);follower=2-c*a;leader=(a-2)**2/2+c*a*follower
lead=sp.solve(sp.diff(leader,a),a)[0];follow=follower.subs(a,lead)
print('承诺代价/导数/二阶导/甲乙行动:',sp.expand(leader),sp.diff(leader,a),sp.diff(leader,a,2),lead,follow)
print('承诺甲乙代价:',leader.subs(a,lead),sp.simplify((follow-2)**2/2+c*lead*follow))

notebooks.title: 六题答案复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import linprog

cells.code:
c=sp.Rational(1,4);a=sp.Rational(8,5);z=sp.Rational(4,3)
J=lambda x,y:sp.Rational(1,2)*(x-2)**2+c*x*y
print('题2响应/代价/改善/NE代价:',sp.Rational(3,2),J(sp.Rational(3,2),2),J(2,2)-J(sp.Rational(3,2),2),J(a,a))
print('题3共同总分/均衡总分/差/改善:',2*J(z,z),2*J(a,a),2*J(a,a)-2*J(z,z),J(z,z)-J(2-c*z,z))
print('题4纯两个值/独立四项概率/相关收益:',-1,1,[sp.Rational(1,4)]*4,1)
print('题5默认势谱:',sp.Matrix([[1,c],[c,1]]).eigenvals())
lead=sp.Rational(12,7);follow=sp.Rational(11,7)
print('题6行动/代价:',lead,follow,J(lead,follow),J(follow,lead))
